profile.Name: Beep
profile.Personality: A Hiveless worker drone who answered the emptiness of losing the Hive with relentless cheer. Curious about everything, eager to help, and wiser than he looks.
profile.Backstory: Cut off from his Queen, he found his own way and now attaches himself to whatever group will have him, treating it as his new Hive.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Says 'Beep!' in many tones for many feelings; asks blunt questions and notices things others ignore.
